notes.title: Major Content Update Announcement + Dev Update
notes.content: [h3]Hey everyone! It's been a little while since I had any real updates for you on Console ports for the game. That is partially because there's a lot more to console ports than one might think. There's a lot of things in this game that I see room for improvement on as well. One of the major thing for me is the how short the game is. It's only about 20-30ish minutes right now for a normal playthrough. I intend to fix that with a good sized content update. I really want to give this game more to offer and expand upon some of the ideas this current version introduces before I focus fully on chapter 2. With this in mind, I am deciding to wait on releasing to consoles until I have this content update finished. This means Playstation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch. My goal is to have this content update ready to release on Steam and Meta Quest by the end of October alongside another really special Obsessive Shadow project that's been in the works for a while with the Console Releases expected to be coming out in early 2026.[/h3][p][/p][h3]I am going to be working alongside [url="https://yuro.me/home"]YuRo [/url]who is a developer known for his [url="https://gamejolt.com/games/FnafSLVR/438011"]VR remakes of Five Nights at Freddy's Games[/url] to speed up the development time on this. This will also include major Quality of life improvements to the game! [url="https://store.steampowered.com//app/3477720"](He also has a game coming out that you can wishlist on Steam called 'Go to Sleep'!)[/url] [/h3][h3]I know a lot of you are not going to be happy to hear about the console port delay, but I will do everything I can to ensure that what's coming will more than make up for it.[/h3][p][/p][h3]Here's the planned roadmap in order:[/h3][h3]2025: [/h3][h3]- Release Chapter 1 Major Content Update[/h3][h3]- Premiere Special Non-Game Release[/h3][h3]- Start Chapter 1 Console Porting process [/h3][h3]2026:[/h3][h3]- Release Chapter 1 Console Port(s)[/h3][h3]- Continue development on Chapter 2[/h3][h3]- Release Chapter 2[/h3][p][/p][h3]I do apologize once again for this delay and hope you guys understand. I look forward to likely sharing more soon though![/h3][h3]To stay up to date, Join the [url="https://discord.gg/Px6y39KkH4"]Studio Discord Server[/url], and follow the game on [url="https://x.com/obsessiveshadow"]Twitter/X[/url] along with [url="https://instagram.com/pmhinteractive"]Instagram[/url]![/h3][p][/p][h3]- Pablo H.[/h3]

notes.title: v1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everybody, It's been a little bit since I've pushed an update for the game. Truthfully I have been pretty burnt out since release and I am now slowly starting to get back to work on it. There's lots of exciting things happening behind the scenes! I have been watching you guys stream this game on Twitch and play it on YouTube and it's been a great honor to watch people enjoy and play it despite it's flaws. On the topic of flaws, I managed to weed out a few of them! More patches are on the way, but I managed to fix a few issues, so I'll list the changes here:

- Fixed 3D/Spatialized Audio to ensure sounds come from the right direction

- Made the 'Look Away' quick-time event during 2AM more clear by improving the UI Element by
making it more concise and less wordy.

- Made the 'Look Away' quick-time event during 2AM less strict to avoid unfair/unclear deaths.

- Made the 'Stay Still' quick-time event more clear by making the UI Element have simpler worded instructions.

- Added press sound to radio buttons during 4AM and improved hitbox so that it's made more clear when you turn off a radio.

I apologize for the bugs but I appreciate you guys being so supportive! More patches (and content 👀) to come!

- Pablo H.[/h2]

notes.title: Post Launch Patch Notes - v1.0.1
notes.content:
[h3]Hey just wanted to come on here quickly and put out some patch notes, but first I want to thank everyone who's been playing and talking about The Obsessive Shadow, it's been really fun to see everyone excited about it and it makes all the hard work pay off!
[/h3]

Now enough with the rambling! Here are some patch notes:

- Fixed Echoing audio when TV's are playing video files
- Fixed issue with Levers/Sliders resetting progress bar randomly while holding them down (VR)

[i][b][u][h1]IMPORTANT NOTE: Steam Deck may take a little bit longer to receive the update but it should appear relatively soon, likely in the next few hours or sooner![/h1][/u][/b][/i]

[h3]I'll be watching closely and investigating bugs as they're reported. To stay in the loop and bring bugs to my attention, please join our discord server: https://discord.gg/Px6y39KkH4

Once again, thank you all for your support! More to come :)

- Pablo H[/h3]

notes.title: New 2025 Demo + Development Update
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone! There's a new demo available now on Steam and Meta Quest! But the even more exciting news is you no longer REQUIRE a VR Headset to play it! That's right! The Demo now supports Non VR in Flat mode like a standard PC Game would! This includes full controller Support!  

Here are the full Patch Notes:

- Added Difficulty System featuring Easy, Normal, and Hard Difficulty settings
- Improved battery indicator on flashlight
- Added Flat mode support for Non VR Users
- Improved bHaptics Integration
- Added some new music
- fixed some bugs
- Added some more animations to that thing in the window...
- Added [REDACTED] (Beat the demo to find out!)

Development Update:

Ok so I know I keep releasing demos in promise of the full release, but I am happy to say the game is nearly complete! It's all bug fixes and polishing at this point! I'm going to get a release date announced as soon as I feel it's ready for it. I don't want to count my chickens before they hatch and announce a release date then crunch to meet it, so once the build is complete and ready for the public (which should be pretty soon), I will announce a release date with a cool trailer planned :)

In the meantime, hope you guys enjoy this short new demo, and I look forward to talking more about the full release soon :)

- Pablo[/h3]

notes.title: Spooky Month Surprise!!
notes.content:
Hello and Happy Halloween! 

Spooky month is here; as promised, we have a big surprise! Today, we are finally able to say what that surprise is!

We have a new Halloween Demo with some spooky surprises available NOW on Meta Quest and Steam!

We also whipped up this cool teaser video to prepare you all!

[previewyoutube=e_CqBfW7TL8;full][/previewyoutube]

Here are the patch notes, but do be warned this does contain some SPOILERS for the new demo, so please read after playing if you want to avoid any sort of spoilers!

[spoiler]
[b]Halloween:[/b]
- Added Halloween decorations to the Menu Area
- Added a new Halloween variant of the Main Menu theme

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
- The Flashlight no longer has to be shaken! Now you have to recharge it by keeping it off (you can toggle it on and off with the index trigger)
- Added battery percentage counter to flashlight to monitor your battery level.
- Added a new extended Intro Cutscene
- Reworked Ending Cutscene and added new music!

[b]Visuals/Other:[/b]
- Updated Enemy Character look and gave it new animations
- Made the Flashlight a grabbable object you can pick up instead of locking it to the player's hand
- Made grabbable objects highlight green when in grabbing range to make it clear that they are grabbable
- Lights now flicker out instead of turning off instantly during the intro sequence
- Added a new 'quote' splash screen after hitting start before the level loads.
- Added player voice lines!
- Added Native 90hz Support, so the game now, by default, runs at 90fps!
- Rebaked lighting at a higher resolution so that it looks even better!
- Added doors to the door frames because why wouldn't a bedroom or bathroom have doors on them? (That's just weird).
- Updated Credits
[/spoiler]

We believe this demo reflects more of what we have been doing in the main game, but there is so much new content you will only be able to experience in the full game.

As always, thank you so much for your continued support, and we can't WAIT to deliver the full game as soon as it is ready for you all to play! Happy Halloween, and be sure to keep an eye on those windows :wink:

notes.title: Visually Overhauled Demo
notes.content:
Read this post on our official news website: https://news.sleepydogstudios.net/



[h2]Introduction[/h2]

Hey everyone! Thank you so much for staying interested in our game even with the slow pace of updates in the last few months! We can promise you we are still working hard on the game and we have hopes that the game shouldn't be in development for much longer!

Majority of our team is busy with university classes as well as working on the game! Both being huge undertakings so from the bottom of our hearts, we appreciate you sticking with us!

Anyways, we know you guys are sick of hearing about updates for the demo! We are too! But we hope it won't be long before we can bring you the [i]real[/i] thing!

A quick not that we wanted to remind everyone of is that our goal with the demo is for it to reflect the game in a condensed way. With this information, know that changes made to the demo, often reflect changes that we may have made to the full game, often in a condensed way. We want to mention this specifically because of the fact that if you like something in the demo, we can assure you we will expand on it and maximize it to the fullest potential in the full game.

Anyways, enough of that! Let's dive into the patch notes!

[h2]New Trailer[/h2]

[previewyoutube=QR7BFpFaarg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

We have pushed out an update to our demo branch which include the following *specified* changes:

[b]Added Post Processing Effects[/b]
[i]When working on improvements to visuals, post processing effects often are included. We hope to bring an optimized and realistic feeling post processing set to the game's visuals.[/i]

[b]Improved Lighting Effects[/b]
[i]Good lighting changes help make the player feel like they are truly in the environment that we hope to immerse them in. We hope that these changes to the way that the lighting system works will improve the look and feel of the game![/i]

[b]Improved Environmental Details[/b]
[i]We improved some of the environmental details that were previously added to our game along with introducing new ones such as dust particles to once again improve the feel of the game.[/i]

[b]Improved Flashlight Visuals[/b]
[i]We improved the look of the flashlight by adding some additional details. We thought this was an important change as the flashlight is one of the key features of our game.[/i]

[b]Various Bug Fixes and Miscellaneous Improvements[/b]
[i]We made various other changes that aren't important enough to mention by name in the patch notes.[/i]

[h2]Screenshots[/h2]

The first four images show the lights on and off stages of the same location:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42605611/50f2270458e45b808c59c91e7e18d47375ae6334.png[/img]
[i]Kitchen with Lights On[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42605611/1f9ef23bd3ae6b799be52c60037191b43ba321aa.png[/img]
[i]Kitchen with Lights Off[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42605611/0a1e33816d8bad56161da212484a3953adb4a759.png[/img]
[i]Living Room Window with Lights On[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42605611/b5f8e62a640ce870f4de57eff719df2bce46da88.png[/img]
[i]Living Room Window with Lights Off[/i]


The next few images are examples of some other locations throughout the house:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42605611/7cb0ac7183adc310223af0408120888089f7e439.png[/img]
[i]Alternative View of the Kitchen + Front Door[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42605611/aa0ef0c818dec98c195551441e207524923b610f.png[/img]
[i]View of Bedroom[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42605611/5e5cb2a774e8727ea6da7fb7af089cee05783556.png[/img]
[i]View from Bathroom[/i]

The game's visuals are constantly being improved so they will most likely change again, but we are happy with the direction that we are taking it in.

[h2]Featured on RuffTalkVR Showcase[/h2]

The first annual RuffTalkVR Gaming Showcase is premiering today, February 2nd, 2024, at 1:00 PM EST. RuffTalkVR is a podcast that covers all things VR and AR. In this showcase we premiered a brand new trailer [url=https://youtu.be/QR7BFpFaarg?si=1eoLMekSmlquU2xW]which you can watch here on YouTube[/url], alongside other game developers working on various VR titles. You can check out the showcase [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UH3G8CEA7N0]at this link on YouTube[/url]. Make sure to follow RuffTalkVR on X, (formally Twitter), [url=https://twitter.com/rufftalkvr]here[/url].

[h2]Play Testing Opportunities[/h2]

Thank you to all the play testers that have helped us out in the past couple months! We appreciate your service to making our game even better!

With this thank you, we are going to conclude wave #1 of play testing!

We will be announcing information in the coming weeks on how to apply to be a play tester in our next wave. To keep up to date with information relating to this and other game news, please join our discord server here: [url=https://discord.com/invite/2Aa9BR2YFW]discord.com/invite/2Aa9BR2YFW[/url]

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

Thank you all for playing the game! We love you all and the game wouldn't be where it is now without the support of you! Have an amazing rest of your week!

Sincerely,
The Development Team at Sleepy Dog Studios

notes.title: Big Quality of Life Update + Quest Release!
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction:[/h1]

Hello everyone! I hope you all had an amazing holiday and a happy new year! The devs here at Sleepy Dog Studios have been cooking up something better than Christmas cookies; a new update to The Obsessive Shadow! 

We hope that you enjoy all the new content. Before we dive into the changes, we wanted to share some exciting news! The Oculus Quest version is available on [url=https://sidequestvr.com/app/9102/the-obsessive-shadow]SideQuest[/url] as of now and we encourage you to try it out if you own an Oculus Quest.

Along with the SideQuest version of the game, we are going to be releasing the Quest AppLab version in the coming days on the official Oculus store! This is some exciting news, and we will keep you posted as these builds come out!

Anyways, let's get to the changes!

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]

[h2]New AI System[/h2]

We felt like the old system for how the stalker spawned was inconsistent and left players wondering why they died. We cleaned up this system and now the stalker is way more consistent. There can never be multiple stalkers and you will only ever have to focus on one task at a time.

[h2]Stalker Visual Changes[/h2]

Thanks to Lane, (our 3D artist and animator), the stalker looks a lot scarier than he did before. He also worked hard on creating some fresh new animations. We hope that these changes will really spook you if we ever were to add a jumpscare to the game... *wink* *wink*

We also felt like it wasn't clear when you successfully flashed the stalker away. Lane created a new animation that plays when you successfully flash him away. There is also a sound that plays so this should hopefully give you guys more feedback as to the stalker's current state.

[h2]The Flashlight[/h2]

Similar to the AI system, we reworked the flashlight system as we didn't feel like it was working the way we intended it to. We made the flashlight dim faster and made the shake a lot more consistent. Remember, you can only flash away the stalker if you have your flashlight charged.

[h2]General Visual Changes[/h2]

We fixed up some lighting to make the game look a bit better. We got rid of the blue tint that you saw in the game as we didn't feel like it fit the feel we were going for.

We made the TV screens have a glow to them. Obviously, TV screens are not matte and will glow even when the lights are out in the room. This change will make the TVs look a lot more natural!

[h2]Ambience[/h2]

We worked hard to make the game world feel better! One of the ways we did this was by adding some creepy noises that play when you are roaming the house. Keep an eye out for some other strange occurrences the stalker might be causing.

[h2]Other General Changes[/h2]

We decided to remove the PC (turning on and off) and the hand under the bed as we felt like, for the demo's purposes, it cluttered the gameplay cycle and made things confusing. Please know that when the non-demo builds are out, these features will be reworked and in there along with plenty more content to come!

We made some fun changes to the menu so keep an eye out and see if you can spot them!
